title: Norsine at Allagash in August 1976 running a tag-trace-retrieve exercise

tellings.quote: He said he was doing a TTR um tag trace retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device

plain: In August 1976, at the Allagash Waterway in Maine, a man named John Norsine was running what he called a TTR, a "tag trace retrieve" exercise using a subcutaneous device, one placed under the skin. Charlie Foltz, who counts himself a witness to the events there, tells Michels this is what Norsine told him, which would mean a planned operation was going on at the place and time of the reported abduction.
